content: Chart.js (~60KB, Canvas 2D, MIT) is the general-purpose, batteries-included dashboard chart library; uPlot (~48-50KB gzipped) is smaller/faster, purpose-built for time series with less built-in styling API; ApexCharts (~164KB gzipped) has more chart types/animations but heaviest; lightweight-charts (TradingView OSS, ~45-60KB, Apache-2.0) is purpose-built specifically for financial price/candlestick/line charts with the best out-of-box crosshair/price-scale UX for financial data. Cross-checked across multiple 2026 sources.
